_comment: Emote tab locks by slot (interface 216 contents subindex), as cache script 702 tests them: an emote is unlocked when its varbit or varp is at least `min` (default 1), or one of `values`. Slots 0-21 and 54 have no lock; 43 (Skill cape) and 44 (Air Guitar) are resolved by Emotes.plugin.js itself. Messages: Stronghold, Drill Demon, mime, gravedigger, holiday, Uri, Premier Shield, Relic unlock and Fortis Salute texts follow OpenRune-Server's EmotesScript (the Wiki doesn't quote them); Flex, Explore and Crab dance texts are ours, from the Wiki's Emotes unlock column.
